articles.title: The four restrictions Tom Brady faces from the NFL that 'hurt' his contract with FOX
articles.standfirst: Brady’s dual roles as a FOX analyst and Raiders minority owner come with rules
articles.summary: Brady’s dual roles as a FOX analyst and Raiders minority owner come with rules
articles.body:
Tom Brady’s transition from NFL superstar to television analyst has brought him a lucrative second career, but his broadcasting responsibilities are complicated by his ownership stake in the Las Vegas Raiders.

The seven-time Super Bowl champion signed a 10-year, $375 million contract with FOX, earning approximately $37.5 million annually. He also became a minority owner of the Raiders after NFL team owners approved the deal in October 2024.

However, combining these positions means Brady must follow strict league rules governing his access, commentary and potential return to playing.

His first season in the broadcast booth wasn’t easy. Brady initially struggled with excessive preparation and relying too heavily on notes.

Over time, he refined his approach, focusing more on analysing matchups and anticipating plays. FOX’s NFL broadcasts averaged 18.7 million viewers during the 2025-26 season, representing a six percent increase.

The four NFL restrictions affecting Brady’s broadcasting role

The NFL introduced safeguards to address potential conflicts of interest arising from Brady’s dual roles. While some restrictions have been adjusted, the rules continue to influence his work as FOX’s lead analyst.

One major limitation concerns access to team facilities. Brady faces restrictions on visiting NFL facilities, observing practices and gathering information directly from players and coaches.

This can make preparing for broadcasts more challenging, particularly when team insights could strengthen his analysis.

His participation in production meetings has also been restricted. Brady was initially prohibited from attending these sessions both in person and virtually, limiting his opportunities to hear directly from coaches ahead of games.

The NFL subsequently relaxed some rules, allowing him to participate remotely, although his access remains different from that of other broadcasters.

Another significant challenge involves public criticism of officials and rival teams. League rules restrict Brady from making certain public comments about referees and other clubs.

Viewers often expect a former quarterback of his experience to offer opinions on controversial decisions and opposing teams, making this limitation particularly relevant to his broadcasting role.

The final restriction concerns a potential return to the field. Brady can’t resume playing in the NFL while retaining his ownership interest in the Raiders.

In an interview with CNBC, he acknowledged asking the league about a possible comeback, although he said officials weren’t enthusiastic about the idea. The NFL also raised potential salary-cap complications involving an active player who owns part of a franchise.

Brady subsequently reiterated that he was happy in retirement, despite enjoying the opportunity to play in a flag football event.

"I actually have inquired, and they don't like that idea very much," said Brady . "So I'm going to leave it at that.

"We explored a lot of different things, and I'm very happily retired. Let me just say that, too."

FOX pays Brady for his football knowledge and distinctive perspective, but league regulations limit some of the access and commentary that could enhance his coverage.

However, improved performances in the booth and rising viewership suggest the partnership continues to deliver value.

articles.title: Who is Candice Swanepoel, the 38-year-old Victoria's Secret supermodel rumored to be dating Tom Brady?
articles.standfirst: The South African model has built an international fashion career, raised two children and established her own business
articles.summary: The South African model has built an international fashion career, raised two children and established her own business
articles.body:
C andice Swanepoel is attracting fresh attention after a report claimed she has been dating former NFL star Tom Brady .

According to Us Weekly, a source said the pair had been together “for a while,” although neither Swanepoel nor Brady has publicly confirmed the alleged relationship.

The reported romance has sparked interest in Swanepoel , who is one of Victoria's Secret's best-known models and has spent nearly two decades working in the fashion industry.

While Brady became famous through his record-setting American football career, Swanepoel built her own reputation on international runways and magazine covers.

Born and raised in Mooi River, a small town in South Africa, Swanepoel was discovered by a talent scout when she was just 15.

According to her official website, she began securing modelling work across Europe the following year before eventually moving to New York to pursue her career full-time.

Her career quickly developed, bringing opportunities to work with major fashion publications and luxury designers.

She became particularly associated with Victoria's Secret after joining the brand in 2007, later earning Angel status and becoming a regular presence at its fashion shows.

How Candice Swanepoel became a Victoria's Secret star

Swanepoel's relationship with Victoria's Secret has been a defining part of her professional life.

She has appeared in the brand's campaigns and runway shows alongside some of the industry's most recognisable models, helping establish her as an international fashion figure.

She also appeared in the brand's famous Fantasy Bra campaign in 2013, wearing a heavily jewelled design that attracted considerable attention.

Her work has extended beyond lingerie, with editorial appearances and campaigns across the wider fashion and beauty industries.

More recently, Swanepoel returned to the Victoria's Secret runway for the 2026 fashion show in Los Angeles. Her continued involvement with the brand demonstrates the longevity of a career that began when she was a teenager.

Away from modelling, Swanepoel has developed her own business interests, including Tropic of C, a swimwear label. The venture has given her another role in fashion, allowing her to work on a brand beyond her modelling assignments.

Her personal life has also included a long-term relationship with Brazilian model Hermann Nicoli . The pair met when Swanepoel was 17, became engaged in 2015 and eventually separated in 2018.

They share two sons, Anacã and Ariel, and Swanepoel has spoken about the importance of balancing motherhood with her professional ambitions.

The dating reports have also drawn comparisons with Brady's previous marriage to fellow supermodel Gisele Bündchen .

The former couple married in 2009 and divorced in 2022. They share two children, Benjamin and Vivian , while Brady also has a son, Jack, with actress Bridget Moynahan .

Since his divorce, Brady has been linked in media reports to several high-profile women, including model Irina Shayk and social media personality Alix Earle .

In January 2026, he told People: “You know what? I don't have much time for a personal life or much time for myself, but I love working and I love my kids.”

For now, the connection between Brady and Swanepoel remains a reported romance rather than a publicly confirmed relationship.

Neither has commented on the claim, leaving details about when they may have started seeing each other unclear. Until either speaks publicly, the story remains based on an unnamed source rather than confirmation from the two stars.

articles.title: Distraction in the Octagon: Tom Brady’s rumored girlfriend, Candice Swanepoel, steals the spotlight at UFC 333
articles.standfirst: Victoria’s Secret model draws celebrity praise at UFC 333 amid reports of her relationship with the NFL legend
articles.summary: Victoria’s Secret model draws celebrity praise at UFC 333 amid reports of her relationship with the NFL legend
articles.body:
Candice Swanepoel turned heads at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi, attracting attention from fans as speculation surrounding her reported romance with NFL legend Tom Brady continues to make headlines.

The Victoria’s Secret Angel attended the October 24 event at Etihad Arena, where she opted for a black outfit for the occasion. The supermodel later shared pictures from her visit on Instagram, giving followers a glimpse of her experience at the high-profile mixed martial arts event.

“Kicking off my Abu Dhabi trip @ufc! What a wild and amazing experience!” Swanepoel wrote in her caption, thanking Visit Abu Dhabi for its warm hospitality and welcoming atmosphere.

UFC 333 featured two championship contests, with Alexander Volkanovski defending the featherweight title against Movsar Evloev . The bantamweight championship was also on the line, as Petr Yan faced Merab Dvalishvili.

While the fighters provided the night's sporting drama, Swanepoel's appearance became a talking point across social media.

Her Instagram comments quickly filled with compliments from celebrities and fans. WWE star Nattie simply described the model as “Gorgeous,” while UFC ring girl Kristie Pearson expressed her excitement about meeting her, writing, “It was so nice to meet you.”

Other followers praised her looks, while some couldn't resist mentioning her rumored relationship with Brady , leaving affectionate comments about the pair.

Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel's reported romance draws attention

Interest in Swanepoel's appearance comes amid reports that she and Brady have been quietly dating for several months. Us Weekly first reported their relationship, and People subsequently cited sources who said the pair had been spending considerable time together.

“They both live in Miami, so it's very convenient,” a source told People, adding that they're seeing each other frequently. Another insider claimed the relationship had been kept private, with the pair taking precautions to avoid attracting attention during their meetings.

Neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly confirmed the reported romance, leaving fans to rely on media reports and social media speculation.

Away from her personal life, Swanepoel has established herself as more than a runway model. She's worked with luxury fashion houses, including Chanel, Versace, Fendi and Dior, and launched her sustainable swimwear label, Tropic of C, in 2018. She serves as the brand's founder and creative director.

Brady , meanwhile, shares three children with his former partners. He has Benjamin and Vivian with ex-wife Gisele Bündchen , and son Jack with actress Bridget Moynahan.

Swanepoel also has two sons with former fiancé Hermann Nicoli , whom she separated from in 2018.

Swanepoel's Abu Dhabi appearance has added another chapter to the growing public interest surrounding the reported couple. While the UFC delivered its championship action inside the Octagon, the supermodel's arrival ensured that celebrity watchers had plenty to discuss outside it.

articles.title: Is the clock ticking? Kirk Cousins addresses the growing threat of Fernando Mendoza
articles.standfirst: Kirk Cousins opened the door to a quarterback change as the Raiders face a crucial decision with Fernando Mendoza waiting for his opportunity.
articles.summary: Kirk Cousins opened the door to a quarterback change as the Raiders face a crucial decision with Fernando Mendoza waiting for his opportunity.
articles.body:
The Las Vegas Raiders went from excitement to uncertainty in a matter of weeks. After a promising start to the season, the team has entered a downward spiral and suffered its fourth consecutive loss after falling to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7 .

The defense continued to show major issues, but the offense failed to provide many answers as well. Kirk Cousins threw two touchdown passes, although both came when the game was already virtually decided and could not change the outcome.

While the veteran quarterback has had some positive moments this season, his lack of mobility has become a limitation for Las Vegas’ offense. As a result, the possibility of the franchise handing the keys to rookie Fernando Mendoza is gaining momentum as the team searches for a spark.

Cousins, however, made it clear that he would not resist if the Raiders believe a change is what’s best for the organization.

“If I’m not the best option, then I don’t want to be out there either,” Cousins said when asked about the possibility of the team replacing him in the starting lineup with Mendoza. “I want our football team to have the best chance to win games. If the first OTA, that had become apparent, I would’ve been the first one to say, ‘Yeah, you can’t play me.’ So, nothing changes. The organization will do what they feel is best, but I feel that Fernando’s done a great job and has a bright future ahead. I’m gonna try to go out there and play as well as I possibly can to help us win and give him a great example to learn from until he does go out there eventually.”

Could Kirk Cousins become a trade candidate?

If Las Vegas decides to move forward with Fernando Mendoza as the starter, it could open the door for a potential Kirk Cousins trade before the deadline.

The 38-year-old quarterback can still be an attractive option for teams searching for stability at the position due to injuries or inconsistent play. His experience and ability to lead an offense could make him an intriguing piece on the trade market.

The New York Giants , Minnesota Vikings , and even the Cleveland Browns could emerge as possible destinations that evaluate the situation.

Inside the organization, there is an understanding that Cousins is unlikely to be the long-term answer at quarterback. His arrival was always viewed as a short-term solution, so a strong offer involving draft capital could push the Raiders toward a major decision and officially hand control of the offense to Mendoza.

The Raiders are running out of time

The matchup against the Rams appeared to be the perfect opportunity to end their losing streak. Los Angeles entered the game after two straight losses and dealing with significant injury issues, but Las Vegas failed to take advantage.

Beyond the final score, the defeat exposed the problems affecting the team on both sides of the ball. The offense lacked rhythm, while the defense was unable to slow down a team that also entered the game with questions.

Defensive coordinator Rob Leonard , who created optimism after a strong start to the season, is beginning to face criticism over the lack of adjustments and the unit’s inconsistency.

With pressure mounting, the Raiders need an immediate response against the New York Jets in Week 8 . Another loss could accelerate major decisions within the franchise and push the quarterback change debate into the spotlight, with Fernando Mendoza becoming the center of attention.

articles.title: Tom Brady's alleged 'girlfriend', Candice Swanepoel, cruelly rejected him years ago and chose Brad Pitt and Justin Bieber instead
articles.standfirst: Fresh reports linking the retired NFL quarterback to the Victoria's Secret supermodel have revived an old celebrity interview
articles.summary: Fresh reports linking the retired NFL quarterback to the Victoria's Secret supermodel have revived an old celebrity interview
articles.body:
Tom Brady is once again making headlines away from the football field, with reports suggesting that the seven-time Super Bowl champion has found a new romantic interest in Victoria's Secret model Candice Swanepoel .

However, the speculation has also brought an awkwardly amusing moment from the model's past back into the spotlight.

Years before the pair were linked romantically, Swanepoel took part in a celebrity version of the party game "Marry, Kiss, Kill", in which she had to choose between three famous men: Brad Pitt, Justin Bieber and Brady . Her answers were not particularly flattering for the former New England Patriots and Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback.

Swanepoel chose Pitt as the celebrity she would marry, selected Bieber for a kiss and left Brady with the remaining option.

The clip has gained renewed attention following the recent reports about the pair, creating an unexpected connection between an old interview and the latest celebrity dating speculation.

The game was intended as light-hearted entertainment rather than a serious declaration of romantic preferences.

Nevertheless, its resurfacing has provided fans with an amusing talking point, particularly given Brady's reputation as one of the most successful athletes in American sporting history.

The former quarterback has spent years in the public eye, winning seven Super Bowl titles and building a career that extended well beyond the NFL.

Yet even his sporting achievements could not secure him the top spot in Swanepoel's fictional celebrity dating choices at the time.

Now, with reports suggesting that the pair have been spending time together, the old answers have taken on a different meaning for social media users.

Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel's reported romance attracts attention

The dating speculation emerged after Us Weekly reported on October 24 that Brady , 49, and Swanepoel , 38, had been seeing each other for some time.

A source told the publication that the pair had been together "for a while", while subsequent reporting from People suggested that they had been dating for several months.

Neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly confirmed the relationship, meaning the reports should still be treated as accounts from sources rather than an official announcement from the pair.

Their reported connection has nevertheless attracted considerable interest. Both are internationally recognised figures, and each has experience navigating the challenges of family life alongside demanding careers.

Brady was previously married to supermodel Gisele Bundchen . The former couple divorced in 2022 after more than a decade together and share two children, Benjamin and Vivian. Brady also has an older son, Jack, with actress Bridget Moynahan .

Since his divorce, the former NFL star has been linked to several high-profile women, including model Irina Shayk .

He has generally kept details of his private life away from public discussion, even as speculation about his relationships continues to attract headlines.

Earlier in 2026, Brady spoke about the demands on his time and the importance of his family in an interview with People.

“I don't have much time for a personal life or much time for myself, but I love working, and I love my kids,” Brady told People in January.

“I like to be busy and try to really stay fulfilled in the things I'm doing, so I'm working on some really cool projects and I'm involved with some great teams of people that are doing some very positive things.”

Swanepoel has also spoken openly about balancing motherhood and her professional ambitions. The South African model shares two sons with her former partner, Brazilian model Hermann Nicoli , from whom she separated in 2018.

In a 2023 interview with V magazine, she discussed the importance of looking after herself while raising her children and maintaining her career.

“She is a constant search for balance, for me at least, and yes I do sometimes feel overwhelmed, but I'm very in tune with my children's needs, then my own personal needs, which are also important,” she told V magazine in 2023.

“Sometimes it's easy to forget. I've realized to be a better mother, I know I need to also take care of myself, whether that be about my [physical] health or mental health or being able to excel in my career and business because it brings me joy and so my children have begun to understand that too.”

She added: “I think it's very healthy and important for them to see everything I do. One of my most vivid memories as a child was seeing my father wake up at 4 a.m. to take care of our farm and his dedication and drive is something that is now part of me and something I hope they will learn from me.”

For now, the old "Marry, Kiss, Kill" game remains an entertaining footnote in the story surrounding Brady and Swanepoel . Her earlier choice was made in a playful setting and offers no reliable indication of how she views him today.

If the dating reports prove accurate, Brady may have moved beyond his earlier place in the game.

But until either star publicly addresses the rumours, the relationship remains unconfirmed, leaving the resurfaced clip as one of the more amusing details to emerge from the speculation.

articles.title: Tom Brady has had enough and is demanding drastic changes to the NFL's refereeing rules: "There's no way!"
articles.standfirst: The NFL legend could barely hide his frustration during the Detroit Lions' narrow victory over the Green Bay Packers
articles.summary: The NFL legend could barely hide his frustration during the Detroit Lions' narrow victory over the Green Bay Packers
articles.body:
T om Brady has made his feelings about the NFL's officiating increasingly clear, and Sunday's clash between the Detroit Lions and Green Bay Packers provided another example.

Working as a FOX commentator, the seven-time Super Bowl champion openly challenged several penalty decisions during Detroit's 20-17 victory, arguing that defenders were being punished for legitimate tackles.

The most contentious moments involved roughing-the-passer calls against Green Bay , including one late in the game that helped Detroit move into position for the winning field goal. Brady's reaction was emphatic.

“No, my goodness. What is that?! There’s no way!… That’s definitely not roughing the passer!” Brady exclaimed on Sunday night.

His frustration resonated with viewers, particularly because his experience as one of the greatest quarterbacks in NFL history gives him a unique perspective on the balance between protecting passers and allowing defenders to compete.

Although Brady has not announced a specific rule-change proposal, his criticism has intensified calls for greater consistency in how officials interpret contact with quarterbacks.

Brady and Blandino question the controversial calls

The game featured several disputed decisions, but the late penalty against Packers defensive tackle Karl Brooks attracted particular attention.

With the score tied at 17-17, Jared Goff completed an 18-yard pass to Sam LaPorta before Brooks was penalised for roughing the passer.

The additional 15 yards helped Detroit advance down the field. The Lions subsequently reached field-goal range, allowing Jake Bates to kick the winning three-pointer as time expired.

Brady was far from the only person questioning the decision. FOX rules analyst Dean Blandino also disagreed with the officials' interpretation, saying: “That’s teach-tape tackle. That’s not roughing the passer.”

The incident was particularly frustrating for Green Bay because another roughing-the-passer penalty earlier in the game had extended a Detroit possession.

The Packers ultimately lost despite having opportunities to secure the victory themselves, including missed field goals and a costly late mistake.

That context matters: the disputed penalties did not account for every reason Green Bay lost, but they significantly influenced the closing stages and left players, commentators and supporters questioning the standard being applied.

NFL protection rules face renewed scrutiny

The NFL has introduced and refined protections for quarterbacks over the years to reduce dangerous contact, particularly when a passer is in a vulnerable position.

Under the league's rulebook, roughing the passer is a 15-yard penalty, and certain violations can also result in an automatic first down.

The challenge is determining where legitimate defensive contact ends and an illegal hit begins. Defenders must react in fractions of a second, while officials must judge the timing, location and nature of a tackle in real time.

Brady's criticism reflects a concern that excessive interpretation could discourage defenders from pursuing quarterbacks aggressively, even when their actions appear consistent with normal football technique.

Fans echoed that frustration online. “ Tom Brady has been killing the officials all game for increasingly soft personal foul calls for late hits and roughing the passer in Detroit. Considering the source, perhaps the NFL pays more attention? Nah,” one fan wrote.

“I do like when Tom Brady gets mad at soft calls. Totally agree,” Andrew Perloff shared on X.

Pat McAfee also praised Brady for speaking out, writing: “I really appreciate Tom Brady’s disdain for some of these Roughing The Passer calls. He’s an owner and one of the lead commentators.. he’s got A LOT OF WEIGHT,” McAfee shared on X.

Brady's dual role as a broadcaster and minority owner of the Las Vegas Raiders adds another dimension to his comments. His opinions carry considerable visibility, although there is no guarantee the league will change its rules in response.

For now, the controversy highlights the difficult task facing NFL officials: protecting quarterbacks without turning ordinary tackles into game-changing penalties. Brady's reaction has ensured that debate will continue well beyond Detroit's narrow win.

articles.title: Klint Kubiak just broke Fernando Mendoza’s heart: He’s all in on Kirk Cousins
articles.standfirst: The calls for Fernando Mendoza to take over are growing, but Klint Kubiak made his decision clear
articles.summary: The calls for Fernando Mendoza to take over are growing, but Klint Kubiak made his decision clear
articles.body:
The Las Vegas Raiders are going through a difficult stretch after suffering their fourth consecutive loss against the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7 of the NFL season. With a 3-4 record , the team’s playoff hopes are becoming more complicated, while pressure continues to grow for changes within the organization.

One of the biggest debates centers around the quarterback position. A portion of the fan base is calling for rookie Fernando Mendoza , the No. 1 overall pick in the Draft, to replace veteran Kirk Cousins . After the loss to the Rams, head coach Klint Kubiak left the door open to evaluating every possibility, but he later clarified his stance.

The coach was clear: Cousins remains the Raiders’ starting quarterback, and there is no competition for the job.

“There is no controversy there,” Kubiak told reporters on Monday. “He’s playing at a very high level. … Excited for him to go play against the Jets.”

Despite the team’s losing streak, Cousins has not been the main issue for Las Vegas. The veteran quarterback currently leads the NFL with 16 touchdown passes and, while his lack of mobility presents a challenge, he has avoided making too many mistakes and has not been consistently pressured by sacks.

The Raiders’ problems lie elsewhere, mainly with their defense and running game. Until those areas improve, a quarterback change would be unlikely to solve the team’s struggles. For now, the franchise has a clear plan for Mendoza and has no intention of rushing his development.

Kubiak says Fernando Mendoza will get his opportunity

The patience of some fans is beginning to run out, but the Raiders were not viewed from the start as a team built to compete for a championship. Their perfect 3-0 start raised expectations, but the reality of the season has turned out differently.

Before the season began, Las Vegas was considered a rebuilding team, focused more on the future than on an immediate Super Bowl push.

With constant calls for Mendoza to see the field, Kubiak assured that the young quarterback will get his opportunity, but it will happen according to the organization’s timeline.

“Fernando is going to play football,” Kubiak said. “We have a plan. We don’t have a timeline for that. Kirk is playing well, and we’re in the hunt.”

From Kubiak’s perspective, the offense is not yet in the ideal situation to hand the reins to a rookie. The Raiders have struggled to establish the running game and rely too heavily on one consistent playmaking receiver, a situation that could make Mendoza’s transition more difficult.

The schedule has also not helped the Raiders. Their last four losses came against teams with legitimate Super Bowl aspirations, not just teams fighting for a playoff spot.

The outlook could improve in Week 8 against the New York Jets , who enter with a 2-5 record , but challenging matchups against the San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks are waiting afterward. If the organization decides to hand the offense over to the rookie in a favorable situation, that opportunity could come now or potentially in the matchup against the Chargers in Week 14 .

articles.title: Gisele Bundchen breaks silence on Tom Brady's new relationship: Why she says Candice Swanepoel hasn't broken ‘girl code'
articles.standfirst: The former Victoria's Secret models have known each other for years
articles.summary: The former Victoria's Secret models have known each other for years
articles.body:
T om Brady 's reported new romance has attracted an unexpected controversy, with Candice Swanepoel facing criticism for dating the former NFL quarterback because of her professional connection to his ex-wife, Gisele Bundchen .

However, the suggestion that Swanepoel has betrayed a close friend appears to be based on a misunderstanding of the relationship between the two supermodels.

According to TMZ, sources familiar with the situation say Bundchen doesn't believe Swanepoel has broken any unwritten rules about dating a friend's former partner.

The explanation is straightforward as although the women have known each other for years and worked within the same fashion circles, they were never particularly close.

The report offers a different perspective on a romance that has generated considerable interest since details of Brady and Swanepoel 's relationship emerged.

Bundchen and Swanepoel share a connection through Victoria's Secret, where both established themselves as internationally recognized models.

Their careers brought them into contact at industry events and professional engagements, creating the impression that they belonged to the same close social circle.

However, TMZ reports that their relationship never developed beyond a friendly professional association.

Sources described the women as supportive of one another throughout their careers but said they had not been seen spending time together in recent years.

That distinction is central to Bundchen 's reported position on the relationship.

While some social media users have accused Swanepoel of violating "girl code," those familiar with the situation say Bundchen doesn't consider the romance a betrayal.

The Brazilian model hasn't personally issued a public statement addressing the controversy, with her reported feelings instead coming from unnamed sources.

Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel dating since June

The relationship between Brady , 49, and Swanepoel , 38, reportedly began in June, although the pair managed to keep their romance largely private for several months.

According to TMZ, they have preferred spending time at quieter locations near Indian Creek in Miami rather than visiting popular celebrity destinations.

Their approach has allowed them to develop their relationship without attracting the level of attention typically associated with Brady 's personal life.

Neither has publicly discussed the romance in detail, leaving much of the information surrounding their relationship to emerge through reports from sources.

Gisele has built a new life since Brady divorce

Brady and Bundchen finalized their divorce in October 2022 after 13 years of marriage, bringing an end to one of the most recognizable relationships in American sports.

They share two children, Benjamin and Vivian, while Brady also has an older son, Jack, from his previous relationship with Bridget Moynahan .

Bundchen has since moved forward with her own personal life, marrying jiu-jitsu instructor Joaquim Valente in 2025 after welcoming their first child together earlier that year.

Her reported reaction to Brady 's new relationship suggests that the former couple are continuing to pursue separate lives without becoming involved in each other's romantic decisions.

Despite the speculation surrounding Swanepoel 's connection to Bundchen , there's no indication that the two women have experienced a personal falling-out.

The controversy appears to have developed largely from assumptions about a friendship that, according to those familiar with the situation, was never especially close.

articles.title: Living the single life: Tom Brady completely devoted to Candice Swanepoel, but has no plans to settle down
articles.standfirst: The seven-time Super Bowl champion reportedly enjoys spending time with the supermodel but remains cautious about another serious commitment
articles.summary: The seven-time Super Bowl champion reportedly enjoys spending time with the supermodel but remains cautious about another serious commitment
articles.body:
Tom Brady appears to have found happiness with Candice Swanepoel , but the seven-time Super Bowl champion is approaching his latest romance very differently from the long-term commitment that defined much of his personal life.

Nearly four years after his divorce from Gisele Bundchen , the 49-year-old former quarterback is reportedly enjoying spending time with Swanepoel without feeling any pressure to establish another serious relationship.

The pair have been romantically linked for several months, although they have gone to considerable lengths to keep their meetings away from public attention.

According to Page Six, Brady is comfortable with his current circumstances and has no intention of rushing into another major commitment, despite his growing connection with the South African supermodel.

"Tom has been seeing Candice and really likes spending time with her," a source told the publication.

However, the insider added that the retired New England Patriots star is not "looking to jump into another serious relationship just yet."

Brady 's approach reflects the changes in his personal life since his 13-year marriage to Bundchen ended in October 2022.

The former quarterback has been linked to several women since their separation, but none of those reported relationships has developed into another public long-term partnership.

"He was married for a long time and doesn't appear to be in any rush to settle down again," the Page Six source explained. "His main focus is still his kids and career."

That position doesn't necessarily rule out a more serious future with Swanepoel .

According to the same report, Brady remains open to a deeper commitment if their relationship develops naturally, although there is no suggestion that either is currently planning such a step.

Swanepoel and Brady have kept romance private

The couple's relationship reportedly began several months before news of their connection became public.

Both live in Miami, allowing them to meet regularly without having to arrange complicated travel schedules.

"They both live in Miami, so it's very convenient," a source told People. "They're spending a lot of time together."

Another insider claimed the pair have taken deliberate measures to avoid being photographed together, while Swanepoel has reportedly shared details with only a small circle of trusted acquaintances.

Neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly confirmed the relationship, maintaining the privacy that has characterized their time together.

Brady prioritizes family as Gisele moves on

Brady shares two children with Bundchen , Benjamin, 16, and Vivian, 13. He also has a 19-year-old son, Jack, with former partner Bridget Moynahan .

Swanepoel , 38, is similarly balancing her personal life with parenthood, raising sons Anacan, 10, and Ariel, seven, from her previous relationship with Hermann Nicoli .

Bundchen has also moved forward since the divorce, welcoming a child with Joaquim Valente in February 2025 before marrying him later that year.

Brady continues working as Fox Sports' lead NFL analyst, a role that keeps him closely connected to the sport following his retirement.

His reported relationship with Swanepoel may eventually develop into something more substantial, but sources suggest the former quarterback is perfectly content allowing things to progress at their own pace.

articles.title: Victoria's Secret supermodels vying for Tom Brady: Candice Swanepoel and Joan Smalls at odds over love?
articles.standfirst: The reported romance between Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel has sparked speculation about a rift between the Victoria's Secret models
articles.summary: The reported romance between Tom Brady and Candice Swanepoel has sparked speculation about a rift between the Victoria's Secret models
articles.body:
T om Brady 's reported love life has become the subject of fresh celebrity gossip, with supermodels Candice Swanepoel and Joan Smalls at the centre of claims about a possible falling-out.

The former NFL quarterback is reportedly dating Swanepoel , but speculation about his alleged past with Smalls has raised questions about whether the new relationship has damaged a longstanding friendship.

According to reports published this week, Smalls is upset about Swanepoel's reported involvement with Brady .

The two models have known each other for around 15 years and have worked together throughout their careers, including on campaigns and the Victoria's Secret runway.

However, the details surrounding the alleged dispute remain unconfirmed. Neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly confirmed their relationship, while the claims about Smalls' reported history with the seven-time Super Bowl champion have not been independently established.

The rumours gained traction after fans noticed that the two models appeared to have unfollowed each other on Instagram.

Their lack of visible interaction at the 2026 Victoria's Secret Fashion Show, where both women walked, added to the speculation.

According to Page Six, sources claim Smalls was particularly unhappy after reportedly having an on-and-off relationship with Brady before Swanepoel became involved with him. The report also suggested that Smalls had encouraged mutual friends to choose sides. These accounts have not been confirmed by either model.

Alleged social media comments fuel the feud rumours

The speculation intensified after screenshots circulated online showing comments allegedly posted by Smalls in response to questions about her friendship with Swanepoel, reported by The Daily Mail.

“You're not friends anymore with Candice?” one fan reportedly asked.

According to screenshots shared by celebrity gossip account DeuxMoi, Smalls responded, “I'm not friends with backstabbers.”

In another allegedly deleted comment, she appeared to criticise the way the friendship had ended, writing: “And the disrespect and carelessness in how they treat you is so unimaginable,” according to a screenshot published by Just Jared.

“There's no going back. Some people lack humility and moral compass. And the way they gaslight, lie and minimize your feelings is the worst slap in the face after 15 years of friendship. Not a sorry said or written. Onwards and upwards!”

The authenticity and full context of the deleted comments could not be independently verified. Representatives for the models had not publicly clarified the situation in the reports cited.

The pair's professional history makes the rumours particularly striking. They have appeared together in fashion campaigns, including an Anne Klein collaboration last year, and both featured in this year's Victoria's Secret Fashion Show. Their apparent lack of interaction at the event prompted further questions about whether their relationship had changed.

Brady's reported romance and Gisele Bündchen's reaction

Brady , who divorced Gisele Bundchen in 2022 after 13 years of marriage, has reportedly been dating Swanepoel for several months. Us Weekly reported that the pair had been together "for a while," citing an unnamed source, while TMZ reported that their relationship began around June. Neither has publicly confirmed the details.

Bundchen has also been drawn into the discussion because she and Swanepoel share a connection to Victoria's Secret.

However, TMZ reported that sources close to Bundchen do not consider the reported romance a betrayal, explaining that the two women were friendly but never particularly close.

Brady and Bundchen share two children, Benjamin and Vivian. He also has a son, Jack, from his previous relationship with actress Bridget Moynahan.

Swanepoel , meanwhile, previously had a long-term relationship with Brazilian model Hermann Nicoli . The pair met in 2005, became engaged in 2015 and later separated.

For now, the alleged tension between Swanepoel and Smalls remains a story driven by reported sources and social-media speculation.

Whether Brady's reported romance is directly responsible for a breakdown in their friendship has not been confirmed, leaving questions about the models' relationship unanswered.

Brady , who divorced Gisele Bundchen in 2022 after 13 years of marriage, has reportedly been dating Swanepoel for several months. Us Weekly reported that the pair had been together "for a while," citing an unnamed source, while TMZ reported that their relationship began around June. Neither has publicly confirmed the details.
Bundchen has also been drawn into the discussion because she and Swanepoel share a connection to Victoria's Secret.
However, TMZ reported that sources close to Bundchen do not consider the reported romance a betrayal, explaining that the two women were friendly but never particularly close.
Brady and Bundchen share two children, Benjamin and Vivian. He also has a son, Jack, from his previous relationship with actress Bridget Moynahan.
Swanepoel , meanwhile, previously had a long-term relationship with Brazilian model Hermann Nicoli . The pair met in 2005, became engaged in 2015 and later separated.
For now, the alleged tension between Swanepoel and Smalls remains a story driven by reported sources and social-media speculation.
Whether Brady's reported romance is directly responsible for a breakdown in their friendship has not been confirmed, leaving questions about the models' relationship unanswered.

articles.title: Gisele Bundchen reveals why she turns down 99% of job offers at 46 after Tom Brady's divorce
articles.standfirst: The supermodel reflects on life and career years after her split from Tom Brady
articles.summary: The supermodel reflects on life and career years after her split from Tom Brady
articles.body:
Gisele Bundchen says she turns down 99% of the job offers she receives , and her main reason is something many moms would do if they could: spend more time with their children. At 46, the supermodel weighs each opportunity against the family moments she might miss.

In a cover story for i-D, Bundchen said she asks herself whether accepting a job would mean missing her daughter’s volleyball game, an outing to the park with her youngest son or time spent watching her oldest son DJ. As she explained, the answer usually comes easily and leads her to turn down the offer.

Gisele Bundchen is prioritizing more time with her children

That focus on family also came through in a recent report by PEOPLE. Citing a source close to Bundchen, the magazine said she is in a “very happy” place, enjoying life in Miami with her family and wishing her ex-husband, Tom Brady, the best. The report came amid news that the former quarterback is dating model Candice Swanepoel.

Gisele Bundchen shares two children with Brady: Benjamin, 16, and Vivian, 13. The former couple, who married in 2009, finalized their divorce in 2022. Bündchen and her current partner, Joaquim Valente, welcomed a son in February 2025. She is now balancing life as a mother of three with the demands of a high-profile career.

Her outlook marks a shift from the pace she kept early in her career. Bündchen recalled working as many as 360 days a year and feeling that she couldn’t turn down major projects. Today, she says she has nothing left to prove to anyone and chooses how to spend her time and live her life.

For Tom Brady’s ex-wife , those everyday moments now carry significant weight when she decides which offers to accept.
